text:
Ivy (Design): Quick check on compact trace toolbar: should Copy ID be primary or inside kebab? Trying to reduce clutter on mobile.

Noah (Product): Keep Copy ID visible. Support folks copy this a lot.

Devin (Eng Runtime): Agreed. Keep it, but make it icon-only with accessible label. Also propose keyboard shortcut when trace focus is active.

Kai (A11y): Must expose full context to screen readers. Use aria-label like 'Copy Request ID 9e1f...' and add an sr-only element with the full id. Also announce a polite live region when copied.

Ivy (Design): Good. What about the permalink idea? Snack with 'ID copied · Open link'?

Noah (Product): Yes, include permalink in snackbar as a small action.

Devin (Eng Runtime): Implementation sketch: icon button (44px min), aria-describedby -> sr element, title shows short id. Snackbar uses aria-live=polite and doesn't steal focus.

Kai (A11y): Ensure tooltip text is duplicated in aria attributes for keyboard users. Check contrast in dark mode.

Ivy (Design): I'll update Figma: primary icons = Pin, Collapse, Copy ID. Kebab holds Export, Download HAR, Open in new tab.

Devin (Eng Runtime): Effort estimate: ~1 dev day + 0.5 day QA/a11y. Can land next patch.

deploy-bot: Patch window opens in 90m.

Noah (Product): Thanks — will review Figma and finalize copy.
